runtime_boundaries_identified: Electron main / preload / renderer process split
In-process ExtensionHost (plugin-sdk) vs remote WebSocket extension peer (server-sdk + server-runtime) — two coexisting plugin runtimes
Main-process-embedded server channel vs standalone server-runtime bin (background process boundary)
Renderer vs main import boundary (type-only imports so Node/Electron runtime is not pulled into renderer)
Child-process runtimes: MCP stdio subprocess and Godot sidecar subprocess

rationale: Verified every load-bearing claim against the checkout. Current desktop is Electron apps/stage-tamagotchi (main/preload/renderer); the legacy Tauri crates/ path is absent from this checkout and the answer never mistakes it for current. Confirmed: 2 renderer HTML entries (electron.vite.config.ts:101-104); manual injeca composition root (main/index.ts:132-246); window-creation abstraction (reusable.ts:5-37, services/electron/window.ts:20-123); generic createRequestWindowEventa (shared/eventa/index.ts:97-105); in-process ExtensionHost with two-layer extension∩module permission model (plugin-sdk core.ts:56-60, 249-327); manifest v1 schema with five permission areas (plugin-sdk shared/types.ts:233-253, 264-300, 322-328); built-in kits widget/gamelet/tool (plugins/kits/index.ts:95-116); discovery at userData/extensions/v1 with symlink support (plugins/host/index.ts:228, registry.ts:62-164); remote WebSocket peer path (server-sdk extension-peer.ts + plugins/airi-plugin-claude-code depending on server-sdk); server-runtime dropping remote permissions/configSchema/dependencies in extension:announce and extension:module:announce (server-runtime index.ts:685-722, 724-775, vs extension-peer.ts:105-121 sending them); embedded channel-server lifecycle (channel-server/index.ts:357-449); standalone bin (server-runtime package.json:29 + src/bin/run.ts); empty setupBuiltInServer({servers:[]}) shell (http-server/index.ts:22-38); contract-type drift between shared/eventa/index.ts:204-247 and shared/eventa/plugin/host.ts:60-187 (autoReload, kits/modules), acknowledged by TODO at plugin/capabilities.ts:42-44; setMaxListeners(100) at main/index.ts:55-58; three /ws literals per TODO at channel-server/index.ts:103-105. Two minor count imprecisions (15 windows vs 14 + shared helper; ~20 providers vs 25) — neither decision-relevant. No stale documentation was presented as current and no documentation-vs-implementation conflict was relied upon. The recommendation (freeze the practiced seams + light registration layer, defer broad generalization) follows from the verified friction; the four migration steps are incremental, reversible, and carry concrete completion criteria.
